title: 第11章 理所当然的偏心
novel_title: 全民武道：女配小弟他无敌了！
content_zh:
周三上午，近身格斗选修课。

    这门课安槐没选，苏念念选了。

    按理说两人的课表在这个时段分开，安槐应该在另一栋楼上丹药常识。

    但他提前十五分钟就到了丹药常识的教室，五分钟翻完了今天要讲的内容，然后跟老师报备说去趟洗手间，转身去了近身格斗课的训练馆。

    训练馆在操场东侧，半开放式建筑，站在外面的走廊就能看到里面。

    安槐靠在走廊的柱子上，双手插兜，像个路过的闲人。

    训练馆里，二十多个学生站成两排，面对面站着，负责教课的教官是个精壮的中年男人，声音洪亮得能震碎玻璃。

    “今天第一课，不讲套路，先测反应！两人一组，自由攻防，我看看你们的底子！”

    苏念念被分到和一个五班的男生对练，那男生比她高了快两个头，胳膊比她大腿还粗，淬体三重，站在那里像一面墙。

    苏念念把校服外套脱了扔到一边，露出里面的白色短袖，扎了个更紧的马尾。

    “你先来？”苏念念歪头看着对面。

    男生有点犹豫，打女生这事，心理上总有点过不去。

    苏念念看出他在想什么，嘴角一撇。

    “别磨叽，你不来我可来了。”

    话音未落，苏念念已经欺身上前，半步切入近距离，左手虚晃，右拳走了一个极短的弧线，正对着男生的肋部。

    男生条件反射地用手臂格挡。

    苏念念拳头在碰到他手臂的瞬间变掌，掌根贴着他的防御直接推了上去，力量不大，但位置刁钻，正好打在他肘关节内侧。

    男生整条手臂一麻，防御出现空档。

    苏念念右脚横扫，干脆利落地收在男生膝盖外侧，没有真踢，点到即止。

    “死了。”苏念念收回脚，吐了口气。

    教官在旁边看着，用力点了一下头。

    “漂亮，下一组。”

    安槐靠在走廊柱子上，嘴角微微弯起来。

    苏家断岳拳的短距离爆发配合她天生的反应速度，打同级别的对手绰绰有余，格斗天赋确实高，步法也灵活。

    唯一的问题是防守意识偏弱，苏念念性格就是进攻型的，一旦开打就习惯往前冲，遇到比她强的对手容易吃亏。

    安槐在心里记了一笔，回头可以兑换一本适合短距离战斗的防御类辅助功法，塞进她书包里。

    他看了一会儿，确认苏念念在训练馆里一切正常，转身往丹药常识的教室走回去。

    刚走到拐角，迎面碰到一个人。

    沈晨。

    沈晨手里拿着一瓶水，看到安槐先是一愣，随即笑了。

    “你也来看格斗课？”

    安槐微微点头。

    “路过。”

    沈晨挠了挠头。

    “我也是路过……林落雪选了近身格斗，我想看看她适不适应。”

    安槐看了他一眼。这小子确实坦荡得让人心疼，连偷偷关注别人都要如实汇报。
content_en:
Wednesday morning, close combat elective.

An Huai didn't choose this course, but Su Niannian did.

It stands to reason that the two people's class schedules are separated during this period, and An Huai should be studying elixir knowledge in another building.

But he arrived at the elixir knowledge classroom fifteen minutes early. He finished reading today's content in five minutes, then reported to the teacher to go to the bathroom, then turned around and went to the training hall for the close combat class.

The training hall is on the east side of the playground. It is a semi-open building. You can see inside from the corridor outside.

An Huai leaned against the pillar in the corridor, with his hands in his pockets, like a passerby.

In the training hall, more than twenty students stood in two rows, facing each other. The instructor in charge of teaching was a strong middle-aged man with a voice so loud that it could shatter the glass.

"The first lesson today is not to talk about routines, but to test your reactions first! Team up in pairs and attack and defend freely. Let me see what your skills are!"

Su Niannian was assigned to sparring with a boy from Class 5. The boy was almost two heads taller than her, and his arms were thicker than her thighs. He had a third level of body tempering and stood there like a wall.

Su Niannian took off her school uniform jacket and threw it aside, revealing the white short sleeves underneath and tied it into a tighter ponytail.

"Are you coming first?" Su Niannian tilted her head and looked across.

The boys were a little hesitant. It was always difficult for them psychologically to hit girls.

Su Niannian saw what he was thinking and curled her lips.

"Don't worry, if you don't come, I will come."

Before she finished speaking, Su Niannian had already stepped forward and cut into close range with half a step. She feinted with her left hand and moved her right fist in a very short arc, facing the boy's ribs.

The boy reflexively used his arms to block.

Su Niannian's fist changed into a palm the moment it touched his arm, and the heel of her palm pushed directly up against his defense. The force was not strong, but the position was tricky, hitting the inside of his elbow joint.

The boy's entire arm went numb, and there was a gap in his defense.

Su Niannian's right foot swept across and was neatly placed on the outside of the boy's knee. She didn't really kick, just hit it.

"Dead." Su Niannian took back her feet and breathed out.

The instructor looked on and nodded vigorously.

"Beautiful, next group."

An Huai leaned against the pillar in the corridor, the corners of his mouth slightly curved.

The short-range burst of the Su Family's Duanyue Fist combined with her natural reaction speed is more than enough to defeat opponents of the same level. Her fighting talent is indeed high, and her footwork is also flexible.

The only problem is that her defensive awareness is weak. Su Niannian's personality is offensive. Once the fight starts, she is accustomed to rushing forward. She will easily suffer when encountering opponents who are stronger than her.

An Huai made a mental note that she could exchange it later for a defensive auxiliary technique suitable for short-distance combat and stuff it into her schoolbag.

He watched for a while and made sure that Su Niannian was fine in the training hall. Then he turned and walked back to the pill knowledge classroom.

Just as I walked around the corner, I met a person head-on.

Shen Chen.

Shen Chen was holding a bottle of water in his hand. When he saw An Huai, he was startled for a moment and then smiled.

"Are you coming to see the fighting class too?"

An Huai nodded slightly.

"Passing by."

Shen Chen scratched his head.

"I was passing by too...Lin Luoxue chose close combat. I wanted to see if she was comfortable with it."

An Huai glanced at him.This kid is indeed so open and honest that it makes people feel distressed. Even if he secretly pays attention to others, he must report them truthfully.
